bodyAnimationContract.directionRule: Player lookDirection.x / monster player-relative x determines SpriteRenderer.flipX. No8-direction source contract.
bodyAnimationContract.idleRule: Character.StopWalkAnimation resets/stops the walk sequence; stationary pose can be walk first frame. Ranged/Throwing stop/start same sequence for shooting/walking.
bodyAnimationContract.hitRule: Character hitMaterial / Monster whiteMaterial for0.15s, then default. Distinct hand-drawn hurt action is optional enhancement.
bodyAnimationContract.deathRule: Character deathMaterial _Wipe plus deathParticles, hide sprite, OnDeath. Monsters play optional deathParticles, hit flash, hide sprite/shadow then return to pool; dissolve loop is commented out.
bodyAnimationContract.walkMinimumRecommendation: One actually animated walk loop per adopted actor identity, same canvas/root/scale, reviewed in real playback. Still frame is not complete walk motion.
bodyAnimationContract.completionClaim: This audit creates no body frames or animation and does not approve an existing loop.

walkDeliveryContract.acceptance: Actual distinct body movement and loop playback; source mapping/timing, fixed-root scale, light/dark alpha, edge/identity stability. Stills or translated copies do not satisfy walk.

abilities.behaviorZh: 按冷却向附近随机敌人投掷回旋法器；无敌则随机掷出，往返命中造成伤害和击退。
boundaries: Distinct prefabs share BoomerangAbility; do not merge count or icon.

abilities.behaviorZh: 与Lightsaber同属回旋法器；该prefab的伤害、击退、半径、投掷时间、冷却不同。
boundaries: Distinct prefabs share BoomerangAbility; do not merge count or icon.

abilities.behaviorZh: 每次造成伤害事件触发概率判定，成功恢复固定recovery值；不是按伤害百分比等额吸血。
boundaries: Chance per OnDealDamage event heals fixed amount, not damage-proportional lifesteal.

abilities.behaviorZh: 按回血冷却自动恢复生命值；不消耗战斗道具库存，也不恢复灵力。
boundaries: Automatic health recovery, not mana or consumable inventory use.

abilities.behaviorZh: 按冷却朝初始面向作扇弧挥击，旋转OverlapBox检查目标，每次挥击同一目标只伤害一次。
刺击命中后按bleedRate与bleedDuration追加周期伤害；目标死亡终止相应持续伤害。
只依据面向X正负作左右水平刺击，命中伤害和击退；不是自动索敌飞剑。
boundaries: Horizontal left/right stab, not homing flying swords.

abilities.behaviorZh: 范围内寻找最近实体并转向瞄准，无目标则随机方向发射；爆炸投射物命中或飞行结束时产生范围伤害和击退。
boundaries: Periodic direct lightning strike is not Bazooka splash. icon_thunder is visual reinterpretation only; future copy should describe aimed explosive projectile. Frozen UI unchanged.

abilities.behaviorZh: 发射器绕角色旋转，沿当前径向按弹夹连射；不是固定朝面向直线射击。
实际prefab绑定GunAbility，以firerate控制弹夹连发，沿角色面向发射；不是同名ShurikenAbility的shurikenDelay实现。
boundaries: Prefab m_Script is GunAbility; same-named ShurikenAbility source exists but is not this prefab binding.

abilities.behaviorZh: 若干Book绕角色持续旋转，接触敌人时伤害和击退；数量升级可增加环绕物。
向角色附近随机点抛出投掷物，爆裂后等角度发出fragmentCount枚碎片投射物。
抛向附近随机敌人或随机位置；落地生成有持续时长、半径和伤害频率的火区。
按配置倍率提升已注册AOE数值；相关范围能力使用中且尚有升级时可出现。
boundaries: Requires corresponding registered stat in use and configured upgrade levels remaining; not an independent active attack.

abilities.behaviorZh: 按配置整数提升已注册护甲；不是主动限时护盾，也不是环身持续伤害。
boundaries: Passive armor upgrade, not timed shield or aura damage.
